source_text: 当然，我们会的。如果你干的事像个强盗，我们也会宰了你。

text: 我现在对你暂不下定论。不过一个人的荣誉是最重要的，而你显然仍须努力。希望我们下次见面时你已有所改观。
source_text: 我现在对你暂不下定论。不过一个人的荣誉是最重要的，而你显然仍须努力。希望我们下次见面时你已有所改观。

text: 我们正要回镇上。一起走吗？我们有保镖护送。
source_text: 我们正要回镇上。一起走吗？我们有保镖护送。

text: 当然。
source_text: 当然。

text: 今天不行。
source_text: 今天不行。

text: 还有些清理的活儿没干完。我们发现了几个荒废了的强盗窝点没被收拾干净；我猜他们互相火并，我们就能获得更多的弹药和药品。
source_text: 还有些清理的活儿没干完。我们发现了几个荒废了的强盗窝点没被收拾干净；我猜他们互相火并，我们就能获得更多的弹药和药品。

text: 我会为此遗憾终生。
source_text: 我会为此遗憾终生。

text: 在我发作之前你最好从我眼前消失。
source_text: 在我发作之前你最好从我眼前消失。

text: 我们仍看到零星的小群，它们一定是在从沙漠深处和闪光之地向这里迁徙。目前我们看到的还只是一小部分，但比起去年已经好很多了，我们很感谢你。
source_text: 我们仍看到零星的小群，它们一定是在从沙漠深处和闪光之地向这里迁徙。目前我们看到的还只是一小部分，但比起去年已经好很多了，我们很感谢你。

text: 听起来不错。再见！
source_text: 听起来不错。再见！

text: 当然。我们走。
source_text: 当然。我们走。

text: Man, I must be out of my mind. But I'll take you. Let's go.
source_text: Man, I must be out of my mind. But I'll take you. Let's go.

text: Have a good suicide, friend. And for what it's worth, good luck.
source_text: Have a good suicide, friend. And for what it's worth, good luck.

text: I'm heading out. You take care of yourself.
source_text: I'm heading out. You take care of yourself.

text: Well, I don't have much, but what's mine is yours.
source_text: Well, I don't have much, but what's mine is yours.

text: Not that I can think of. I'm heading out. You take care of yourself.
source_text: Not that I can think of. I'm heading out. You take care of yourself.

source_text: We will. I'm heading out. You take care of yourself.

text: I won't lead a possible enemy home. If you do make your way to Shady Sands,# keep your nose clean.

I won't lead a possible enemy home. If you do make your way to Shady Sands,

text: Small. We make our living herding Brahmin. It's pretty rough country# around here, and pasture land is rather precious.

# around here, and pasture land is rather precious.

text: In a Brahmin herding backwater? You've gotta be crazy! There's probably# not a working piece of electronics within two hundred miles.

In a Brahmin herding backwater? You've gotta be crazy! There's probably
# not a working piece of electronics within two hundred miles.

text: You got a point. I think we should play things cautious and go our# separate ways. If I were you, I'd do something about those stories. Unless you# like people hating and mistrusting you.

You got a point. I think we should play things cautious and go our

text: I should kill you right now. You cross my path again, and I will. Now get.
source_text: I should kill you right now. You cross my path again, and I will. Now get.

text: 我想我一定是疯了。我会带你走。走吧。

text: 好好去寻死吧，反正你觉得很值。祝你好运，朋友。

text: 我要出发了，你多保重。

text: 我不会带一个炸弹回家。如果你想去沙荫镇，最好给我规规矩矩的。

text: 村子太小。我们靠养双头牛维生。这儿周围都是贫瘠的荒地，牧场是很宝贵的。

text: 在这放养双头牛的鬼乡下？你一定是疯了！可能这方圆两百里内没有一块能工作的电子元件。
